name: Cheech & Chong - Eighth - Yesca
description:
Indoor-grown, hand-trimmed, top-shelf. The Cheech & Chong Yesca eighth delivers 3.5 grams of premium indoor flower — dense, frosty, and cured for full flavor and a smooth, even burn.

Yesca takes its name from old-school slang, and the flower plays the part: classic herbal and spicy notes up front, brightened by a hint of citrus and finished with a warm, earthy sweetness. Dense, resin-coated buds with a rich, traditional nose — the kind of smoke that feels like it's been around a while, done right.

Why you'll love it:

3.5G premium indoor flower — grown in a controlled environment for consistent quality
Hand-trimmed and properly cured — dense, frosty buds with a smooth, even burn
Signature Yesca flavor — classic herbs and spice with citrus brightness and earthy sweetness
Full terpene expression — rich aroma and flavor straight from the jar
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Premium flower, real flavor, and top-shelf quality in every eighth. Cheech & Chong Yesca is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
